name: Gotify
description: A simple server for sending and receiving messages.
notes: Log in as admin; the password is in /opt/gotify/.nova-secrets (SECRET1).
compose:
services:
  gotify:
    image: gotify/server:latest
    container_name: gotify
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    environment:
      GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS: "{SECRET1}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/app/data
